finalResult.previousParagraphText: [Leaden Black Moss (Epic)] – A rare type of black moss that has evolved after being in contact with a powerful death affinity metal for a period of time while under great care. This moss is extremely dangerous and will erode any vitality-based substance it comes into contact with. Due to its proximity to a powerful metal, small particles of said metal may be found within the moss.
